result.title: MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model
result.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables, including references and appendices
result.summary: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MHWA 多时间尺度层级 world-action 模型，用跨步高层上下文通道降低全局上下文更新频率以抑制自回归 rollout 的漂移累积，并借 context-aware routing 依全局上下文与当前观测动态重配底层专家；在 14 个 Atari 游戏离线数据上以 77M 参数取得 0.884 的 IQM HNS。
AI.relevance_reason: 其多时间尺度 latent 状态更新频率与按上下文路由的 gating，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新节奏、误差累积与长度泛化提供可核查的设计线索，但论文面向离线 RL 世界模型，与视觉推理的具体联系仍待确认。
